newsitem.title: FRANCE: British yacht seized in Med with cannabis aboard.
newsitem.headline: British yacht seized in Med with cannabis aboard.

text.p: French customs said on Friday they had seized 2.6 tonnes of cannabis resin aboard a British sailboat in the Mediterranean.

The Lady Duncan was spotted by a French customs aircraft off Spain's Baleric islands earlier in the week and tracked until it called at Port-Camargue, west of Marseille, on Thursday, the customs service said.
The 14-metre (46 ft) yacht tried to escape when it spotted agents waiting to board it but was stopped by a customs launch.
The three unnamed men on board, identified only as a German, a Briton and a Belgian, were arrested.
Customs said they arrested a U.S. citizen who came to meet the yacht after searching his home and seizing a further 180 kilos (400 lbs) of the drug and $70,000 in Swiss francs and German marks.
